subject.title: perf: avoid event-loop stall during embedded_run bootstrap-context

question: Should OpenClaw permanently replace Node's native `fs.glob` behavior for existing `bootstrap-extra-files` configurations with this cooperative custom walker and yielded bootstrap-hook dispatch?
rationale: The benchmark supports the performance goal, but choosing a permanent resolver and scheduling contract requires maintainer ownership of upgrade compatibility beyond what unit tests or CI can establish.

options.title: Accept the bounded compatibility contract
options.body: Approve the custom walker and yielded dispatch after the core owner accepts responsibility for preserving the documented bootstrap-pattern and hook-ordering behavior.

options.title: Keep the native resolver
options.body: Pause this branch and pursue a narrower event-loop mitigation that retains Node's native glob implementation if exact compatibility is preferred.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded compatibility contract
recommendation.body: Approve the custom walker and yielded dispatch after the core owner accepts responsibility for preserving the documented bootstrap-pattern and hook-ordering behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The hook system and bootstrap hook were introduced and repeatedly maintained in this history by steipete.
